# anthropic_plugin (Data Source)

Beta. Looks up a Claude Enterprise plugin (`GET /v1/organizations/plugins/{id}`). Available to Claude Enterprise organizations only.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "anthropic_plugin" "example" {
  id = "plugin_01EXAMPLE"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) ID of the plugin (`plugin_...`).

### Read-Only

- `components` (Attributes List) What the served version contains. Null when not enumerated. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--components))
- `content_scan` (Attributes) Content scan of the served version. Null when not scanned. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--content_scan))
- `created_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp when the plugin was created.
- `description` (String) Description of the served version.
- `display_name` (String) Display name of the served version.
- `latest_version_id` (String) ID of the newest version.
- `manifest_version` (String) Manifest `version` of the served version, normalized for display. May be null.
- `marketplace_id` (String) ID of the marketplace the plugin lives in.
- `name` (String) Lowercase identifier, unique within its marketplace.
- `organization_installation_preference` (String) Organization-wide installation setting: `required`, `auto_install`, `available` or `not_available`. Null for a member-owned plugin.
- `organization_installation_preference_inherited` (Boolean) True while the organization-wide setting comes from the marketplace default. Null for a member-owned plugin.
- `owner_type` (String) `organization`, or `user` for a plugin in a member's personal marketplace.
- `owner_user_id` (String) User ID of the owning member. Null for an organization plugin.
- `reach` (String) How far the served version reaches: `contained`, `privileged` or `remote`. Null when not classified.
- `served_version_id` (String) ID of the version claude.ai serves to members.
- `served_version_pinned` (Boolean) Whether the served version has been pinned.
- `updated_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp of the last served-version change.

<a id="nestedatt--components"></a>
### Nested Schema for `components`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) What the component declares about itself. Null for MCP servers, hooks and CLIs.
- `name` (String) Name of the skill, command, agent, MCP server key, hook event or CLI executable.
- `type` (String) `agent`, `cli`, `command`, `hook`, `mcp_server` or `skill`.


<a id="nestedatt--content_scan"></a>
### Nested Schema for `content_scan`

Read-Only:

- `assessment` (String) `pass`, `warn`, `fail` or `unknown`. Set only when `status` is `completed`.
- `reason` (String) Main mechanism behind a `warn` or `fail`. Null otherwise.
- `status` (String) `processing`, `completed` or `errored`.
